_comment: One hook, and it branches on the exit code only - never on the words of any output. v2 had a Stop hook that printed its whole report whenever the text contained 'triggers:', which triggers.py printed even when nothing fired, so every turn ended with a clean report dressed as an alarm. There is no Stop hook here. The command is anchored to $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (2026-09-22): a bare tools/hook_check.py broke whenever the shell was not at the repo root.
